mutation_strategy.promotion_rule: promote when deterministic output changes despite unchanged reading order

simple_text.expected_challenge: born-digital simple body text where deterministic parsing should be sufficient

generation_recipe.content_seed: short headings and paragraphs with stable punctuation

simple_text.route_rationale: This family establishes the deterministic baseline and should not require provider calls.

mutation_strategy.promotion_rule: promote when providers disagree on column or footnote order

two_column_ko_en.expected_challenge: two-column Korean and English mixed text with footnotes and reading-order ambiguity

generation_recipe.content_seed: parallel Korean and English sections with numbered footnotes

two_column_ko_en.route_rationale: Deterministic layout extraction should be checked, but VLM fallback may be needed when column order is ambiguous.

mutation_strategy.promotion_rule: promote when markdown or HTML table structure loses merged headers or unit rows

merged_table.expected_challenge: merged cells, nested headers, and unit rows that stress table reconstruction

generation_recipe.content_seed: measurement table with grouped headers and unit row

merged_table.route_rationale: Table extraction is deterministic-first, with provider fallback when merged structure cannot be preserved.

mutation_strategy.promotion_rule: promote when formulas or symbols are substituted with visually similar text

formula_symbols.expected_challenge: formulas, subscripts, arrows, and special symbols that can be lost or polluted by OCR

generation_recipe.content_seed: short derivation with Greek symbols, arrows, superscripts, and subscripts

formula_symbols.route_rationale: Formula-like content needs deterministic text preservation plus provider comparison for symbol loss.

mutation_strategy.promotion_rule: promote when OCR-only output misses chart trend or diagram relationship

chart_like_page.expected_challenge: chart, diagram, or figure explanation where semantic image description matters more than OCR text

generation_recipe.content_seed: small chart with caption, legend, and labeled visual trend

chart_like_page.route_rationale: This is the primary Gemini fallback family because OCR cannot recover the visual semantics alone.

mutation_strategy.promotion_rule: promote when text layer absence causes deterministic extraction to return empty or partial text

text_as_image.expected_challenge: image-only text with no embedded text layer that requires OCR recovery

generation_recipe.content_seed: short bilingual notice rendered as pixels only

text_as_image.route_rationale: The absence of a text layer should route to OCR before any deterministic text extraction is trusted.

mutation_strategy.promotion_rule: promote when orientation correction changes OCR recovery or reading order

rotated_scan.expected_challenge: rotated or skewed scan-like page that needs orientation classification or unwarping

generation_recipe.content_seed: single-page Korean form-like text rotated from upright orientation

rotated_scan.route_rationale: Orientation and OCR capability should be observable without requiring private scan files.

mutation_strategy.promotion_rule: promote when confidence, text recovery, or provider disagreement exposes robustness limits

low_quality_scan.expected_challenge: blurred, artifacted, low-resolution scan-like page that stresses real-world robustness

generation_recipe.content_seed: mixed-language memo degraded with blur and compression artifacts

low_quality_scan.route_rationale: Low-quality inputs should expose whether OCR or VLM fallback improves quality enough to justify cost.
